narrative: Chart of Accounts administration — the MoraBanc planning COA maps the group ledger across income statement, balance sheet and cash flow. AI Auto-Map suggests mappings for unmapped ledger accounts using Cortex, with high accuracy on standard banking lines such as interest income, fee income and impairment.

signals.title: Ledger account export FY2025
signals.excerpt: Active ledger accounts mapped to planning leaf accounts; a small number of legacy codes from the Banco Europeo de Finanzas integration are under review.
